event_lightning_rules.name: event_lightning_rules
event_lightning_rules.value: "sliper"."event_settings"."meetup_type" <> 'lightning' or ("sliper"."event_settings"."amount_krw"=0 and "sliper"."event_settings"."capacity" between 2 and 12 and "sliper"."event_settings"."starts_at" is not null and "sliper"."event_settings"."ends_at" is not null and "sliper"."event_settings"."venue_latitude" is not null and "sliper"."event_settings"."venue_longitude" is not null and "sliper"."event_settings"."starts_at">"sliper"."event_settings"."created_at" and "sliper"."event_settings"."starts_at"<="sliper"."event_settings"."created_at"+interval '7 days' and "sliper"."event_settings"."ends_at">="sliper"."event_settings"."starts_at"+interval '15 minutes' and "sliper"."event_settings"."ends_at"<="sliper"."event_settings"."starts_at"+interval '12 hours')

event_schedule.name: event_schedule
event_schedule.value: "sliper"."event_settings"."ends_at" is null or ("sliper"."event_settings"."starts_at" is not null and "sliper"."event_settings"."ends_at">"sliper"."event_settings"."starts_at")

refund_amounts.name: refund_amounts
refund_amounts.value: "sliper"."refund_requests"."amount_krw" between 0 and 10000000 and "sliper"."refund_requests"."rate" in (0,20,40,60,80,100) and "sliper"."refund_requests"."refundable_krw"=floor("sliper"."refund_requests"."amount_krw"::numeric*"sliper"."refund_requests"."rate"/100) and ("sliper"."refund_requests"."actual_refund_krw" is null or "sliper"."refund_requests"."actual_refund_krw" between 0 and "sliper"."refund_requests"."amount_krw")

refund_completion.name: refund_completion
refund_completion.value: ("sliper"."refund_requests"."state"='pending' and "sliper"."refund_requests"."processed_at" is null and "sliper"."refund_requests"."actual_refund_krw" is null) or ("sliper"."refund_requests"."state"<>'pending' and "sliper"."refund_requests"."processed_at" is not null and ("sliper"."refund_requests"."state"<>'completed' or "sliper"."refund_requests"."actual_refund_krw" is not null))

library_content_size.name: library_content_size
library_content_size.value: char_length(btrim("sliper"."library_entries"."title")) between 2 and 120 and char_length("sliper"."library_entries"."scenario") between 20 and 10000 and char_length("sliper"."library_entries"."rules") between 10 and 8000 and char_length("sliper"."library_entries"."host_guide") between 10 and 8000

library_distribution.name: library_distribution
library_distribution.value: "sliper"."library_entries"."price_krw" between 0 and 1000000 and (("sliper"."library_entries"."price_krw" = 0 and "sliper"."library_entries"."purchase_url" is null) or ("sliper"."library_entries"."price_krw" > 0 and "sliper"."library_entries"."purchase_url" is not null and "sliper"."library_entries"."purchase_url" ~ '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$'))

manner_review_tags.name: manner_review_tags
manner_review_tags.value: cardinality("sliper"."manner_reviews"."tags") between 1 and 2 and (("sliper"."manner_reviews"."sentiment"='positive' and "sliper"."manner_reviews"."tags"<@ARRAY['규칙 준수','배려']::text[]) or ("sliper"."manner_reviews"."sentiment"='negative' and "sliper"."manner_reviews"."tags"=ARRAY['진행 방해']::text[]))

push_deliveries_source.name: push_deliveries_source
push_deliveries_source.value: ("sliper"."push_deliveries"."kind" = 'comment' and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."post_id" is not null and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."comment_id" is not null) or ("sliper"."push_deliveries"."kind" in ('announcement','participation') and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."post_id" is not null and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."comment_id" is null) or ("sliper"."push_deliveries"."kind" = 'test' and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."comment_id" is null)

push_deliveries_local_url.name: push_deliveries_local_url
push_deliveries_local_url.value: char_length("sliper"."push_deliveries"."url") between 1 and 512 and left("sliper"."push_deliveries"."url",1)='/' and left("sliper"."push_deliveries"."url",2)<>'//' and strpos("sliper"."push_deliveries"."url",chr(92))=0 and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."url" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

push_deliveries_lease.name: push_deliveries_lease
push_deliveries_lease.value: ("sliper"."push_deliveries"."status" = 'processing' and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."locked_at" is not null and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."lock_token" is not null) or ("sliper"."push_deliveries"."status" <> 'processing' and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."locked_at" is null and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."lock_token" is null)

push_deliveries_sent_time.name: push_deliveries_sent_time
push_deliveries_sent_time.value: ("sliper"."push_deliveries"."status" = 'sent' and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."sent_at" is not null) or ("sliper"."push_deliveries"."status" <> 'sent' and "sliper"."push_deliveries"."sent_at" is null)
